compressed_items.content: Adaptive Intelligence Theory (AIT); PAGE_00 additionally labels itself Minimal Formal Skeleton (v0.1).
PAGE_5 is source-labeled FINAL SYNTHESIS. The label carries no supersession, canonicality, or program-synthesis authority.

Indexed source-local purposes/questions cover representation, reachability, correction, adaptation, possibility-space expansion, mathematical foundation, and the three final-synthesis questions. Local purpose does not imply scientific standing.
PAGE_00 defines intelligence as expansion of controllable reachability through improved representations while preserving causal access required for continued correction/adaptation.
PAGE_00 preserves the R->Omega->C->A->R genome chain and four differential dynamics dR/dt, dOmega/dt, dC/dt, dA/dt under its local namespace.
PAGE_00 stability forms: Delta Omega_t <= C_t and dOmega/dt <= kappa C_t; no equivalence with later A>=C forms is asserted by compression.
Gamma_t=(dOmega/dt)/C_t is Reachability Expansion Ratio; source interprets <1, approximately 1, and >1 as within, near, and beyond the correction boundary.

PAGE_00 conceptual layer/failure claims preserve representation effects, controllable-reachability scope, correction/adaptation interpretations, learning-vs-adaptation distinction, and failure-mode interpretations without empirical promotion.
PAGE_00 formal failure signatures: dOmega/dt>C; R decreases; A increases while C decreases; C increases while A decreases, interpreted only under PAGE_00 local symbol meanings.
Illustrative correction channels: evolution, science, markets, and AI examples.

PAGE_00 related-framework lists name Representation Elasticity, Adaptive Metric Compiler, Resolution Horizon, Causal Mass, Counterfactual Reachability Mass, Interface-Induced Computational Geometry, Causal Permeability, Alignment Spine, CGET, Recursive Adaptive Dynamics, and Adaptive Evolutionary Dynamics. Exact endpoint identity and edge type remain unresolved.

Source questions include how to increase reality-transforming ability without losing ability to learn from reality and how to expand future influence while preserving conditions for continued improvement.
Proposed experiment independently varies representation quality, reachable action space, feedback fidelity/delay, and self-modification capacity in changing environments.
PAGE_00 predicts sustainable intelligence growth requires dOmega/dt <= kappa C and maintaining coupling between increasing power and continued correction.
PAGE_1 adaptive-loop diagram: Reality -> Observation -> Representation -> Compression -> Prediction/Search -> Action -> Reality Change -> Feedback.
PAGE_1 formal loop R_t->M_t->A_t->E_{t+1}->R_{t+1} and capability-expansion form Delta Omega>0 are preserved under PAGE_1 local meanings.
PAGE_1 defines Omega as the set of possible future states.
Directional possibility-space objective recurs as Delta Omega_good/beneficial > Delta Omega_bad/harmful; recurrence is not independent warrant.
PAGE_1 proposes A_t>=C_t for adaptive stability and C_t>A_t for instability under local alignment/capability meanings.

PAGE_1 says intelligence improves the adaptive loop; capability expands opportunity and risk; representation limits optimization; recursive improvement requires correction; correction without improvement stagnates; central thesis emphasizes improving answer-generating/evaluating processes while remaining corrigible.
PAGE_1 proposes recursively improving representation, action, and error correction while preserving reality contact, reliable feedback, and beneficial-future alignment.

PAGE_2 names RAD, CPP, Alignment Spine, CGET, AMC, Representation Elasticity, Resolution Horizon, CPB, IICG, Causal Mass, Causal Influence, CRM, and Causal Vector Field as AIT components/concepts. Exact program endpoints are unresolved.

PAGE_2 source-side descriptions characterize the purposes/effects of the named framework concepts, including permeability, generative/constraining balance, metric evolution, representational elasticity, phase boundaries, interface geometry, causal mass/influence, CRM, and causal-vector fields. These are R15 interpretations, not imported endpoint truths.

PAGE_2 includes claims that alignment capacity should not lag capability growth, sustained intelligence needs generative/constraining equilibrium, higher representation elasticity generally enables faster adaptation, resolution-horizon reasoning becomes speculative, CPB crossing changes solvable-problem class, and directional expansion favors beneficial over harmful futures.
PAGE_2 claims the named components are facets of one adaptive process and characterizes AIT as a unified framework; this remains source-authored synthesis standing only.
PAGE_2 six-step unifying process: observe, represent, expand possibilities, act, receive corrective feedback, improve the mechanisms repeating the cycle.
PAGE_2 objective: maximum adaptive capability while preserving capacity for continued correction rather than maximum intelligence.
PAGE_3 self-improving loop diagram preserves observation, representation, compression, search/model, action, changed reality, feedback, and updated representation.

PAGE_3 Alignment Spine diagram relates capability expansion/reachable futures, beneficial/harmful futures, and correction channels such as reality feedback, interpretability, evaluation, human values, and self-correction.

PAGE_3 AIT Stack vertically depicts Values/Alignment, Feedback/Correction, Causality/Influence, Intelligence/Search & Planning, and Representation/Compression & Abstraction. Diagram order has no automatic causal/temporal authority.
PAGE_3 illustrates capability growth as expansion of a worst-to-best possibility interval.
PAGE_3 says capability should expand only as quickly as correction can keep pace and repeats Delta Omega_beneficial > Delta Omega_harmful.
PAGE_3 summary describes intelligence as improving representations, expanding controllable futures, and preserving feedback that keeps expansion beneficial.

PAGE_4 preserves S_t=(E_t,R_t,M_t,A_t), state evolution, observation/representation/prediction/action/environment equations, and the Environment->Observation->Representation->Model/Search->Action->Environment flow under PAGE_4 state/action meanings.
PAGE_4 defines Omega(S_t) as future environment states reachable from S_t and partitions Omega into beneficial Omega+ and harmful Omega-.
PAGE_4 capability expansion is Delta Omega=Omega(S_{t+1})-Omega(S_t); partition Omega=Omega+ union Omega-.
PAGE_4 defines Q_R=I(R;E)/C(R), with mutual information over representation/reality and C(R) as representation complexity.
PAGE_4 proposes maximizing useful information while minimizing unnecessary complexity as representation-quality objective.
PAGE_4 calls the representation-quality objective invariant-preserving compression; source label does not establish a proved invariance theorem.
PAGE_4 defines H(S)=f(I,R,C,O) with I=available information, R=representational capacity, C=computational capacity, O=observation quality. These local meanings are not global R/C meanings.
PAGE_4 states computation beyond H(S) yields increasing uncertainty rather than additional recoverable structure.
PAGE_4 defines CM(S) as KL divergence between future-environment distributions conditioned on system presence versus removal.
High CM is interpreted as system removal substantially altering future outcomes.
PAGE_4 defines CRM(S)=|Omega(S)-Omega(not S)|.
High CRM is interpreted as many future states becoming unreachable if the system is removed.
PAGE_4 proposes A_t>=C_t for stable expansion and C_t>A_t for instability under local alignment/capability meanings.
PAGE_4 representation update R_{t+1}=R_t+Delta R(feedback) and core adaptive-system equation S_{t+1}=F(S_t,feedback).
PAGE_4 states F is adaptive rather than fixed and proposes intelligent systems improve transition dynamics while preserving alignment with reality.

PAGE_4 says intelligence improves the loop/optimization process; representations affect reachability; actions transform environment; feedback improves representations; alignment preserves correction; defining property is continual process improvement rather than static capability.
PAGE_5 final-synthesis core model: Reality -> Representation -> Compression -> Prediction -> Action -> Reality Change -> Feedback.
PAGE_5 shorthand R=f(Environment) and capability Delta Omega>0 are preserved as source-local formal statements.
PAGE_5 defines Omega(S) as reachable future space.
PAGE_5 states better representations create larger reachable futures and gives verbal alignment condition Correction capacity >= Capability growth.

PAGE_5 final synthesis names Resolution Horizon, Representation Elasticity, IICG, Causal Mass/CRM, Causal Permeability, CGET, and Alignment Spine with source-local glosses. Exact endpoints unresolved.

PAGE_5 says intelligence improves its own loop, expands opportunity/risk, remains safe when adaptation keeps pace with influence, studies modeling/transforming/creating reality with preserved feedback, and seeks maximum adaptive capability with preserved correction.
